route.arabic_locator: وقال محمد بن إسحاق عن يزيد بن رومان
route.report_summary: When the Messenger was mentioned, al-As ibn Wa'il reportedly said to leave him because he was cut off and without offspring; when he died his remembrance would cease, whereupon the surah was revealed.

required_fragments: محمد بن إسحاق عن يزيد بن رومان

source_comparison.work: Direct Ibn Ishaq or Ibn Hisham recension

decision: Preserve this as Ibn Kathir's separately reported Ibn Ishaq-to-Yazid route. Do not call it an independently verified Ibn Ishaq transmission until a direct earlier witness and edition locator are found.
explicit_absences: No transmitter above Muhammad ibn Ishaq is supplied in this wording.
